`abstract class SliderNode<V>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`BaseSliderNode<V>`](/reference/controls/baseslidernode/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`DoubleSliderNode`](/reference/controls/doubleslidernode/), [`IntegerSliderNode`](/reference/controls/integerslidernode/), [`StringSliderNode`](/reference/controls/stringslidernode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.control.slider` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SliderNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/control/slider/SliderNode.java)

A slider made of two parts: a `track` that covers the control and a `thumb` placed at the value.

## Description

A skin extends one of its subclasses and gives its parts in its constructor; the slider places them on every frame.
A thumb of size `0` is a square of the height of the slider, and the inset is half the width of the thumb unless the skin gives another one.
Attaching a slider without a thumb throws an `IllegalStateException`.

## Creation details

<a id="SliderNode-constructor"></a>

### SliderNode

`SliderNode(double x, double y, double width, double height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Creates the slider at `x`, `y` with a `width` and a `height` in design pixels, from the constructor of a subclass.

## Property details

<a id="SliderNode-property-track"></a>

### track

- `this track(Node track)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Node getTrack()` 

**Default:** `null`

The node drawn behind the thumb, over the whole slider, with a `zindex` of `-1`; optional.

<a id="SliderNode-property-thumb"></a>

### thumb

- `this thumb(Node thumb)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Node getThumb()` 

**Default:** `null`

The node centered on the place of the value; required.

<a id="SliderNode-property-speed"></a>

### speed

- `this speed(float speed)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this speed(Supplier<Float> speed)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `float getSpeed()` 

**Default:** `1F`

How fast the thumb reaches a value set from the code or a signal: the part of the remaining way that it covers in 1/60 s, at any frame rate.
`1F` moves it at once; during a drag, the thumb follows the pointer at once, up to half a step past the last accepted value.
